output.summary: Revenue fell almost entirely in one step in 2023-24, coinciding with fewer concerts (32 to 30), reduced seating capacity and the venue move. Single tickets fell 45% and low-usage subscribers' renewals dropped from 60% to 43%. Since then revenue has been roughly flat, even as post-1945 repertoire kept rising. Engaged subscribers renew at a steady 85-86%, which counts against core-audience defection and against repertoire as the main driver. Peer benchmarks, marketing attribution and travel-time data are missing, so the market-wide, marketing and counterfactual claims stay unestablished. Do not give non-renewal notice on this revenue evidence. Present a segmented analysis first, and separate the artistic review from the revenue question.
